---
title: "Culminating Experience Dashboard (Placeholder Data)"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
#| label: step-1-build-data

month_name <- c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun")
reel_views <- c(1200, 1500, 1800, 2400, 2600, 3100)
story_views <- c(900, 1100, 1000, 1500, 1700, 1900)
retention_rate <- c(0.71, 0.72, 0.74, 0.75, 0.77, 0.79)

dashboard_data <- tibble(
  month_name = factor(month_name, levels = month_name),
  reel_views = reel_views,
  story_views = story_views,
  retention_rate = retention_rate
)
```

```{r}
#| label: step-2-summary-values

total_reel_views <- dashboard_data |>
  summarise(total_reel_views = sum(reel_views)) |>
  pull(total_reel_views)

total_story_views <- dashboard_data |>
  summarise(total_story_views = sum(story_views)) |>
  pull(total_story_views)

latest_retention <- dashboard_data |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  pull(retention_rate)
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Reel Views"

list(icon = "play-circle", color = "primary", value = total_reel_views)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Story Views"

list(icon = "eye", color = "info", value = total_story_views)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Latest Retention Rate"

list(icon = "people", color = "success", value = scales::percent(latest_retention))
```

## Row {height=80%}

```{r}
#| title: "Reel Views by Month"

reel_plot <- ggplot(data = dashboard_data, mapping = aes(x = month_name, y = reel_views, group = 1))
reel_plot <- reel_plot + geom_line(color = "#1b6e5a", linewidth = 1.2)
reel_plot <- reel_plot + geom_point(color = "#1b6e5a", size = 3)
reel_plot <- reel_plot + labs(x = "Month", y = "Reel views")
reel_plot <- reel_plot + theme_minimal()
reel_plot
```

```{r}
#| title: "Data Table"

kable(dashboard_data)
```
